active_exploratory_memories.hypothesis: Prioritizing inspection of open horizontal surfaces before opening closed storage receptacles reduces total search actions compared to strictly following the listed observation order.

probe_summary.evidence_goal: Whether the target object is found on the first visited open surface or requires opening a closed receptacle, and the total action count to acquisition compared to strict list-order traversal.
probe_summary.local_function: candidate receptacle selection order during initial search
probe_summary.realization_pattern: visit an open horizontal surface first; if empty, visit a closed storage receptacle next, opening it before inspection
stop_conditions: target object is successfully taken into inventory
all prioritized open surfaces and one closed storage receptacle have been inspected without success
an action fails or returns an error

active_exploratory_memories.scope: ALFWorld pick-and-place tasks where the target object is not immediately visible and the room contains both open surfaces and closed storage receptacles
